technology.summary: Today's technology news includes the announcement that OpenAI will not go public until its models are safe, according to CEO Sam Altman. BAG Ventures has raised $11.3 million to invest in AI startups, while Airbnb is launching new services such as AI search, meal delivery, and laundry. In other news, Cloudflare plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates, and Charter Space has raised $5 million to bring insurance to space companies.

citations.headline: Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe
Two Google alumni raise $11.3M to back AI startups that enterprises will actually pay for
Airbnb adds AI search, more social features
Cloudflare plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates
Charter Space raises $5M to bring insurance to the stars

finance.summary: Today's most important finance news includes the MSCI Asia Pacific Index climbing 0.6% with stocks in Japan and South Korea gaining, and the Shapoorji Pallonji Group planning to raise $125 million through a tap issue of current dollar bonds. Meanwhile, KPIT Technologies faces a 24% decline in stock value, and the Nifty 50 saw a drop of 64.05 points, or 0.28%, closing at 22,716.20.

citations.headline: Global Market Today: Asian shares rise as tech stocks lead, bonds in focus
SP Group to raise $125 million via tap issue, Rs 3,250 crore in rupee bonds
KPIT Tech plunges 24% in 3 months as auto demand weakens
Stocks in news: Tata Steel, KPI Green Energy, NLC India, Poonawalla Fincorp and Cummins India

politics.summary:
The Maharashtra Government has unveiled a Fodder Development Policy to tackle shortages. The policy will include a list of suitable grasses, fodder-producing trees, improved fodder crops, and traditional and non-traditional sources of fodder.

Governance must change for the age of AI, according to Chandrababu Naidu, who says the next 20 years are crucial for India.

Congress has sought a discussion on CS and Law Secretary letters in the J&K Assembly, while BJP legislators staged a walkout from the Assembly over the Statehood resolution.

The Supreme Court will hear a West Bengal plea against bail to a Nandigram Congress candidate on October 5.

The Kerala HC has directed transparency in the selection of Sabarimala and Malikappuram Melsanthis.

The Keralam government has forwarded proposals by various film bodies to departments concerned ahead of finalising a draft industry policy for Malayalam cinema.

A Lok Sabha bypoll in Tamil Nadu triggered the first Motion of Confidence in the Indian legislature.
